Top up your wallet.

Send money through InstaPay, then upload your receipt. Coins are added after we confirm the transfer reached our account.

Choose coins

Top-ups and cosmetic purchases are final; no discretionary refunds are offered. Required legal rights and manual review of duplicate transfers, incorrect payments or failed delivery remain available.

Send your payment

Check the recipient name and amount in InstaPay before confirming. Include your Lightning account email in the transfer note. The QR may not fill in the amount or note for you.

The image is private and visible to you and authorized administrators. Uploading it does not approve payment.
